what: Scopes people write in a title that mean a product release-please knows by another name. Read by release_scope.py. A scope that is a product's component or package-name needs no line here: those come from the release-please configs.

desktop.why: The desktop app's titles say desktop as often as vitruvian. The other products under apps/desktop have names of their own and are not meant by it.

peripherals.why: gravastar-mouse is released from packages/peripherals, and its titles say peripherals.

remote.why: The Android remote's titles say remote; its component is android-remote.
